title: Job: My Honor Turned to Shame

questions.question: But now they laugh at me, men who are what?
questions.explanation: Job 30:1 (ESV): "But now they laugh at me, men who are younger than I, whose fathers I would have disdained to set with the dogs of my flock."

questions.question: They abhor me; they keep aloof from me; they do not hesitate to do what at my face?
questions.explanation: Job 30:10 (ESV): "They abhor me; they keep aloof from me; they do not hesitate to spit at the sight of me."

questions.question: Terrors are turned upon me; my honor is pursued as by the what?
questions.explanation: Job 30:15 (ESV): "Terrors are turned upon me; my honor is pursued as by the wind, and my prosperity has passed away like a cloud."

questions.question: And now my soul is poured out within me; days of affliction have taken hold of what?
questions.explanation: Job 30:16 (ESV): "And now my soul is poured out within me; days of affliction have taken hold of me."

questions.question: The night racks my bones, and the pain that gnaws me takes no what?
questions.explanation: Job 30:17 (ESV): "The night racks my bones, and the pain that gnaws me takes no rest."

questions.question: God has cast me into the mire, and I have become like what?
questions.explanation: Job 30:19 (ESV): "God has cast me into the mire, and I have become like dust and ashes."

questions.question: I cry to you for help and you do not what?
questions.explanation: Job 30:20 (ESV): "I cry to you for help and you do not answer me; I stand, and you only look at me."

questions.question: You have turned cruel to me; with the might of your hand you do what?
questions.explanation: Job 30:21 (ESV): "You have turned cruel to me; with the might of your hand you persecute me."

questions.question: You lift me up on the wind; you make me ride on it, and you toss me about in the what?
questions.explanation: Job 30:22 (ESV): "You lift me up on the wind; you make me ride on it, and you toss me about in the roar of the storm."

questions.question: For I know that you will bring me to death and to the house appointed for all what?
questions.explanation: Job 30:23 (ESV): "For I know that you will bring me to death and to the house appointed for all living."

questions.question: Did not I weep for him whose day was hard? Was not my soul grieved for the what?
questions.explanation: Job 30:25 (ESV): "Did not I weep for him whose day was hard? Was not my soul grieved for the needy?"

questions.question: But when I hoped for good, evil came, and when I waited for light, what came?
questions.explanation: Job 30:26 (ESV): "But when I hoped for good, evil came, and when I waited for light, darkness came."

questions.question: My inward parts are in turmoil and never still; days of affliction what?
questions.explanation: Job 30:27 (ESV): "My inward parts are in turmoil and never still; days of affliction come to meet me."

questions.question: I go about darkened, but not by the what?
questions.explanation: Job 30:28 (ESV): "I go about darkened, but not by the sun; I stand up in the assembly and cry for help."

questions.question: I am a brother of jackals and a companion of what?
questions.explanation: Job 30:29 (ESV): "I am a brother of jackals and a companion of ostriches."

key_verse_text: But when I hoped for good, evil came, and when I waited for light, darkness came.
